name: REV-INR
definition: A method that replaces multiple models with a single SIREN whose final layer outputs four parameters of a Normal Inverse-Gamma distribution for closed-form estimation of epistemic and aleatoric uncertainty.
summary: REV-INR is an uncertainty-aware implicit neural representation that estimates epistemic and aleatoric uncertainty via a single SIREN network, offering closed-form uncertainty with lower storage than ensembles.
